title: Brandy Alexander Milkshake
ldInstructionsRaw: Chill a glass in the freezer for 5 minutes. Add all of the ingredients to a blender, then blend on high until smooth. Carefully remove the chilled glass from the freezer. Pour the blended milkshake into the chilled glass. Add the toppings to the milkshake. Begin with a generous amount of whipped cream, and grate some fresh nutmeg onto the whipped cream.
